desc: The Cold Steel Trench Hawk features a sharp cutting edge and wedge-style spike, offering numerous tactical options for our nations modern warriors. Drop forged from 5150 carbon steel and differentially hardened, the head of the Trench Hawk will withstand tremendous blows as well as the awful stress of prolonged hard use. The handle of our Trench Hawk is highly resistant to shock and will withstand abuse that would break even a tough hickory handle. The Trench Hawk comes with the Secure-Ex sheath.
